verdict.rationale: Requesty's own MCP Gateway lets users register MCP servers, explore their tools, and configure authentication, including per-user keys. The registered tools are consumed by downstream assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code) connecting through the gateway. Nothing shows Requesty itself, or its router during chat completions, invoking those MCP tools. missing for 10: evidence that the router itself executes MCP tools in requests, detailed setup/transport documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Register new servers, explore available tools, and configure authentication settings.
The MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway enables AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Roo Code to securely connect to MCP servers through Requesty's unified API
Connect your favorite AI coding assistants to Requesty's MCP Gateway for seamless access to external tools and services.
Enterprise plan users can manage their own personal API keys for MCP servers, enabling individual authentication while maintaining centralized server management.
